basics.name: Conor Hinchee
basics.summary: Senior software engineer with 5+ years building ecommerce applications in React, GraphQL and TypeScript, and analytics pipelines in GA4 and tag management. Leads search and AI adoption on the frontend team at Express, a storefront with about 5 million monthly users. Builds AI developer tooling that catches what coding agents miss.

highlights: Led five developers moving search to Google Retail Search, replacing keyword matching with ML-ranked results to improve relevance and conversion.

Lead AI adoption on the frontend team: write the docs and harnesses coding agents work from, build internal MCP servers that help engineers find answers faster, and mentor developers on coding with AI.
Co-maintain pure-react-carousel (express-labs) as one of four npm maintainers, about 67k weekly downloads and 1.7k GitHub stars. Triage issues, review community PRs and publish releases.
Keep the storefront's React app and GraphQL server at a CI-enforced 100% test coverage threshold (Jest, React Testing Library).
Serve on the production on-call rotation: troubleshoot issues in real time with Google Cloud and TrackJS, lead incident response and write postmortems.
Solved high-volume support issues on the first call for non-technical customers.

projects.name: Odin, Claude Code Skill
projects.description: A Claude Code skill that catches what coding agents miss, like tests that fail silently or code that ignores the project's docs. After each task it proposes fixes to the harness (the skills, rules and scripts the agent follows) so the same mistake doesn't happen twice, with human approval gates between plan, build and sign-off.

projects.name: heap-analyzer
projects.description: Finds memory leaks in Node.js apps by diffing three heap snapshots and tracing what keeps each leaked object alive. Built on Facebook's memlab and published on npm.
